{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

blocks.text: Now reinstall the CRAP tooling (wiped again) and run the whole verification pipeline — install, baseline, instrument, coverage, measurement — as one background job:

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"

  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else

blocks.text: Now reinstall the CRAP tooling (wiped again) and run the whole verification pipeline — install, baseline, instrument, coverage, measurement — as one background job:

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

blocks.text: Now reinstall the CRAP tooling (wiped again) and run the whole verification pipeline — install, baseline, instrument, coverage, measurement — as one background job:

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

blocks.text: Now reinstall the CRAP tooling (wiped again) and run the whole verification pipeline — install, baseline, instrument, coverage, measurement — as one background job:

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

blocks.text: Now reinstall the CRAP tooling (wiped again) and run the whole verification pipeline — install, baseline, instrument, coverage, measurement — as one background job:

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi
","path":"/tmp/quality_pipeline.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"
tail -2 /tmp/harness.log

node -e "
const cov = require('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json');
const keys = Object.keys(cov);
console.log('coverage files:', keys.length);
console.log(keys.filter(k => k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1));
"

echo "--- crap4js measurement ---"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json > /tmp/crap-full.txt 2>&1
echo "full-tree crap4js exit: $?"
if [ -s /tmp/crap-full.txt ] && grep -q "triggerBitrise" /tmp/crap-full.txt; then
  grep -E "triggerBitrise|^CRAP Ratchet" -A3 /tmp/crap-full.txt | head -30
else
  echo "full-tree run unusable — two-file fallback:"
  /tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
    js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
    js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
    --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json \
    --threshold 8 \
    --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
fi

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Full local quality pipeline (mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml):
# install tools -> fetch baseline -> instrument -> node harness coverage ->
# two-file crap4js measurement against the released baseline.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
mkdir -p /tmp/base

if [ ! -d "$TOOLS/node_modules/crap4js" ]; then
  npm install --prefix "$TOOLS" --no-fund --no-audit \
    "github:IstiN/crap4js#83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d" nyc@17 > /tmp/npm.log 2>&1 || { echo NPM FAILED; tail -5 /tmp/npm.log; exit 1; }
fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json ]; then
  gh release download crap-baseline --repo IstiN/dmtools-agents --pattern "crap-baseline.json" --dir /tmp/base --clobber || { echo BASELINE DOWNLOAD FAILED; exit 1; }
fi
node -e "
const b=require('/tmp/base/crap-baseline.json');
for (const k of Object.keys(b.functions)) if (k.indexOf('triggerBitrise') !== -1) console.log('baseline:', k, b.functions[k].crap !== undefined ? b.functions[k].crap : JSON.stringify(b.functions[k]));
"

cat > /tmp/crap4js-big.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec /usr/local/bin/node --max-old-space-size=8192 /tmp/tools/node_modules/crap4js/src/cli.js "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/crap4js-big.sh

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; tail -20 /tmp/instrument.log; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"

# keys onto the instrumented root, then run the two-file crap4js ratchet.
set -u
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov
mkdir -p /tmp/cov
rm -f agents
trap 'ln -sfn "$REPO" "$REPO/agents"' EXIT

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$INST" > /tmp/instrument.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "INSTRUMENT FAILED rc=$rc"; exit 1; fi
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' --exclude 'agents' ./ "$INST/"
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST" || exit 1
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES > /tmp/harness.log 2>&1
echo "harness exit: $?"

node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const cov = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cov/coverage-final.json', 'utf8'));
const out = {};
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cov)) {
  const m = k.lastIndexOf('/dmtools-agents/');
  if (m !== -1) out['/tmp/inst/' + k.slice(m + '/dmtools-agents/'.length)] = v;
  else if (k.startsWith('/tmp/inst/')) out[k] = v;
}
fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/cov/coverage-mapped.json', JSON.stringify(out));
console.log('mapped:', Object.keys(out).length);
"

/tmp/crap4js-big.sh \
  js/triggerBitriseTestAutomation.js \
  js/triggerBitriseIosBuild.js \
  --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-mapped.json \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline /tmp/base/crap-baseline.json
","path":"/tmp/final_measure.sh"}
